summary: Code blocks must be indented and surrounded by blank lines, and may only use approved Pygments lexers such as bash, console, ini, jinja, json, powershell, python, shell-session, yaml, yaml+jinja and ansible-output.
questions: Which code-block languages are allowed in Ansible docs?
Is there a lexer for Ansible output?
Why did my code block fail the docs lint test?

answer_card.title: Allowed code-block lexers
answer_card.answer_md:
Allowed: `none`, `ansible-output`, `bash`, `console`, `csharp`, `diff`, `ini`, `jinja`, `json`, `md`, `powershell`, `python`, `rst`, `sh`, `shell`, `shell-session`, `text`, `yaml`, `yaml+jinja` (enforced by `rst-yamllint.py`).
```rst
.. code-block:: python

   def my_beautiful_python_code():
      pass
```
Indent correctly and surround with blank lines.
